Individuals pursuing a PhD in Information and Communications Technologies (ICT) or related fields

The Nokia Foundation Scholarship 2026 is an opportunity provided by the Nokia Foundation to individuals pursuing a PhD in Information and Communications Technologies (ICT) or related fields. This scholarship aims to encourage doctoral candidates to complete their research efficiently and with high quality. The selected students will receive a scholarship of up to 7,500 euros (approx. ₹7,63,747).
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be pursuing a doctoral degree in ICT or related scientific fields in a Finnish University
have at least one accepted publication related to the doctoral dissertation at the time of applying
not have already received this scholarship earlier
have a good record of high-quality, fast-paced doctoral studies
The selected candidates will receive a scholarship of up to 7,500 euros (approx. ₹7,63,747) to support doctoral research and living expenses.

The applicant must obtain a commitment statement from their principal supervisor, who must be a professor, docent, or senior scientist at the university where the applicant is undertaking their degree. This statement must be submitted directly by the supervisor through the electronic application system.
An individual can receive the scholarship only once.
Question: Who is offering this fellowship opportunity?
The Nokia Foundation is offering this opportunity.
Question: Who can apply for this fellowship?
Individuals pursuing a PhD in Information and Communications Technologies (ICT) or related fields can apply for this scholarship.
Question: What are the benefits of this fellowship?
The selected fellows will receive a scholarship of up to 7,500 euros (approx. ₹7,63,747).
Question: What is the last date to apply for this fellowship?
The application deadline for this fellowship is 15 September 2026.
Question: How many times can I receive this scholarship?
An individual can receive this scholarship only once.
